purpose: Phase 1.0 vendor scaffolding for ADR-121 D3-3 (fork codex-windows-sandbox into dasclaw monorepo) — see epic #241.

upstream.commit_subject: Enable unavailable dummy tools by default (#19459)

vendored_paths.reason: Windows OS sandbox implementation (~12k LOC, ~30 modules: sandbox_users, token, cap, acl, workspace_acl, firewall, desktop, dpapi, conpty, setup_orchestrator, ...).
windows-sandbox-rs uses codex_protocol::protocol::{SandboxPolicy, NetworkAccess}. Full crate vendored to keep upstream cherry-picks straightforward; later phases may slim down.

windows-sandbox-rs uses codex_utils_pty::{TerminalSize, SpawnedProcess, ProcessDriver, RawConPty, spawn_from_driver}. Note: dasclaw_pty exists in this repo and may eventually replace this dependency in a later phase.

modifications_in_this_pr: None. This is a verbatim vendor copy. No file in vendor/codex-windows-sandbox/upstream/ has been modified relative to the captured upstream commit. Phase 1.1 will introduce workspace integration (workspace.dependencies, target gating, brand-neutral naming).
workspace_integration_status: DEFERRED to PR-1.1. Vendored Cargo.toml files are intentionally NOT registered in the root workspace (see root Cargo.toml `exclude = ["vendor"]`). Running cargo build/check from the workspace root does not currently compile vendored code.
